# Juice Luxury Rentals

> Text-to-book luxury concierge for group weekends: private villas, exotic cars, crewed yacht charters and chauffeured Sprinters in Miami, plus Potomac yacht charters in Washington, DC. A referral concierge: bookings are fulfilled by licensed operators.

## How booking works
- Text (301) 980-7994 (SMS) with your dates and group size, or DM Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/juiceluxuryrentals).
- Curated options with photos within 24 hours; replies are personal, usually within hours.
- Rates depend on dates, length of stay and season, so the site shows no prices; every quote is for the exact dates.
- A 50% deposit locks the booking; the balance is due before arrival. Cars need a valid license, full-coverage insurance and a security deposit set by the operator.
- Villas and exotic cars are Miami only. Yacht charters run in Miami and on the Potomac in DC. Tables, dinners and drivers in both cities.
